card.name: Partway into drug and number strings
card.fires_on: Short pieces inside a split-up drug class, enzyme or number, such as the D in DPP-4, the P in P-gp, the 3 in CYP3A4, the last 0 in 10,000, or the gap before a section number. Also fires on 'of' or 'with' after 'use'.
